requirements.text: Improve efficiency by reducing phone calls
Increase customer satisfaction by allowing 24/7 appointment scheduling
Reduce no-shows through automated reminders
Gain better visibility into bookings and cancellations to manage schedules effectively
Allow barbers to manage their own schedules independently, setting their own availability
Track customer no-show history to address repeat offenders appropriately
Enable customers to create accounts to store their details and preferences
Provide a user-friendly interface for selecting services
Each barber will have a profile showcasing their specialties and real-time availability
Ensure customers can choose from available time slots, preventing double bookings
Send instant confirmation of appointments via SMS or email after booking
Allow customers to easily cancel or reschedule their appointments online
Implement a feedback and rating system for customers to share their experiences
Include a promotions section for seasonal deals or discounts during booking
Provide customers access to their booking history when they log in
Send automated reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before appointments via SMS or email
Offer a one-time grace period for first-time visitors to cancel or reschedule without penalties
Budget constraints require a cost-effective solution for both initial setup and ongoing operational costs
Ensure compliance with data protection laws to protect sensitive customer information
Design a user-friendly system that minimizes the need for extensive training
Enforce a cancellation policy requiring a minimum of 24-hour notice
